hook_text: Is a square a rectangle? Yes. And a rhombus. And a kite.
clip_script: A square has all four sides equal AND four right angles. It is a parallelogram, a rectangle and a rhombus all at once, because it satisfies every one of their definitions. A rhombus is a parallelogram with all four sides equal; it looks like a pushed-over square.
visual_style: An A4 sheet folds into a square; the square is pushed over into a rhombus; a family tree diagram lights up every branch the square belongs to.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to build a kite and name every quadrilateral.
